findings.body: Following the skill’s discovery instructions leaves the two required answers sourced as `client recap reply` (`src/forge/templates/skill.md:101-102`). The newly instructed `forge decision accept` call rejects every must-answer source other than `client`, `salesperson`, or `developer` (`src/forge/records.py:278-285`). It therefore stops before the strict review for a client who followed this workflow. Reconcile the recorded source with the validator so the read-back can lead to review.
findings.title: Not done: Sign-off is read back and reviewed first

findings.body: `forge next` uses `open_must_answer_topics`, which does not list a syntactically valid answer sourced from `agent` or `our default` (`src/forge/nextstep.py:106-111`). Sign-off rejects those sources (`src/forge/records.py:278-285`). The instruction can therefore send the agent into the single read-back call with an incomplete list of topics to settle.
findings.title: Correct the claim that forge next lists every open must-answer topic
